initiatives.title: OpenDent ↔ AutoCount + E-Invoicing
initiatives.why: LHDN e-invoicing is mandatory Jan 2027 — the non-negotiable trigger. AutoCount does the upward LHDN reporting. This is the data backbone everything else (dashboard, locum, recall ROI) plugs into.
initiatives.next: Confirm hardware installed & demo integration tested; specify Tailscale for the remote tunnel.
initiatives.gate: Contract SIGNED 22 Jun 2026. Payment gated: RM10k over 3 months, released against UAT milestones (RM3.5k + RM3.5k + RM3k).
initiatives.timeline: ~2 months buy-to-live (2wk demo+test → live), then 1–2 days for the remote tunnel.

initiatives.title: Referral Engine (CX-driven, opt-in)
initiatives.why: We're a premium, trust-based practice — referrals must be earned through experience, not bought (no MLM, no discounts; the segment isn't price-sensitive). A great end-to-end experience makes referral automatic.
initiatives.next: Intern compiling the high-ticket value list. When ready → Lu presents to GM → gate Elaine-as-caller → trigger calls.
initiatives.gate: Premium-positioning gate: rewards = goodwill (e.g. RM50 NGO food voucher per successful referral), never clinic discounts.
initiatives.timeline: Three stages: (1) CX so good referral is automatic → (2) the referral → (3) post-referral thank-you. Intern building list now.

initiatives.note: Box 1 = Customer Experience (pre/in/post-visit + physical space = #5). Box 2 = the referral. Box 3 = thank the referrer when their referral shows up + produces. NGO voucher = food money for them + goodwill/moral gain (clinic invests in an NGO).

initiatives.title: Front-Desk Referral Tracking
initiatives.why: Front desk doesn't currently capture 'who referred you?' at onboarding, so referrals are invisible and unrewardable. This is the measurement layer the referral engine needs.
initiatives.next: Add a 'referred by?' question to intake/onboarding and a simple way to log it in OpenDent/CRM.
initiatives.timeline: Quick win; prerequisite for referral attribution (#9) and the physio channel (#8).

tasks.t: Add 'how did you hear about us / referred by?' to intake

initiatives.note: Without this we can't measure referral ROI or thank referrers. Front-desk executed; serves CRM/Retention.

initiatives.title: Extend Operating Hours
initiatives.why: Raises the hard 762-chair-hour/month capacity ceiling — the one lever that lifts the cap. Also serves the 'can't come during working hours' churn segment and may open new markets.
initiatives.next: Model the economics: which extra slots, staffing/locum cost, expected fill from the can't-come-in-hours segment.
initiatives.timeline: Decision Q3 → phased implementation Q4 if the economics work.

tasks.t: Size the can't-make-working-hours demand (from CRM calls + recall replies)

Pilot an evening / weekend block

initiatives.note: Capacity insight: today ~554/762 chair-hrs used (~73%); maxing hours alone caps ~RM367k/mo — extending hours lifts the ceiling itself. Pairs with CRM/retention (families lost to working-hours conflict).

initiatives.title: Legal — Contracts, Handbook & Doctor Agreements
initiatives.why: Doctors currently have NO contract. Redraft all employee contracts, refresh the employee handbook, and move doctors onto contractor agreements (NOT employees) so they do not fall under an employment relationship. Reduces employment/legal risk and locks the doctor-engagement model.
initiatives.next: Legal counsel drafting now. In-flight: (1) all employee contracts redone, (2) employee handbook updated, (3) doctor contractor agreements + a doctor policy as an appendix, (4) Elaine moved off front desk to a Customer Relationship Manager role.
initiatives.timeline: In progress — external legal person engaged.

Update the employee handbook
Doctor contractor agreements (contractor, not employee)

initiatives.note: Doctors sign a CONTRACTOR agreement (not employment) to avoid employee classification; the doctor policy rides as an appendix. Elaine — with iSmile since inception, known to long-standing patients as the front face — shifts off front desk (age making front-desk load heavy) into a CRM Manager role: she becomes the caller for the high-value CRM reactivation list (ties to the CRM Reactivation initiative). Home = Finance & Governance (legal/compliance); also a People & HR initiative.
